issues.legal_issue: The aggregation of the annual letting values of individually exempt properties cannot create a property-tax liability when the charging provision supplies no applicable rate for those properties.
material_facts: The owners held multiple properties in the same municipality, each with an annual letting value not exceeding the statutory exemption threshold.
The municipality aggregated the properties’ annual letting values and assessed property tax on that basis.
The charging provision specified no tax rate for an individual property whose annual letting value did not exceed the threshold.
The High Court upheld the assessment, and the owners challenged the assessment and the validity of the aggregation proviso.
issues.conclusion: The aggregation proviso was contrary to the charging provision and was struck down as ultra vires; the appeal was allowed and the High Court’s judgment was set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 126, 127(1), and 127-A(1) and (2)(b) of the Madhya Pradesh Municipalities Act, 1961, the tax must have a clearly specified subject, liable person, and rate. A taxing statute is construed according to its plain language; a tax cannot be imposed by inference or analogy, and a court cannot supply an omitted rate by adding words or relying on the statute’s presumed purpose. The Court applied the strict-construction principles quoted from Bank of Chettinad Ltd. v. Commissioner of Income-tax, Madras, Inland Revenue Commissioners v. Duke of Westminster, and Russel (Inspector of Taxes) v. Scott. It rejected the contrary construction in Administrator, Municipal Corporation, Bilaspur v. Dattatraya Dahankar, Advocate, which treated the aggregated properties as one unit for taxation.

rule.if: municipal_property_tax_challenge and individually_exempt_properties and values_aggregated_for_assessment and charging_scheme_omits_applicable_rate

predicates.municipal_property_tax_challenge: The proceeding challenges the validity of a municipal property-tax assessment or the provision used to impose it.
predicates.individually_exempt_properties: Each property at issue has a value that places it within the statutory exemption when considered individually.
predicates.values_aggregated_for_assessment: The taxing authority combines the values of multiple properties to assess tax on properties that are individually exempt.
predicates.charging_scheme_omits_applicable_rate: The charging scheme does not specify a rate applicable to the properties on the basis used to assess them.

issues.definition: When a municipal property-tax challenge concerns individually exempt properties assessed by aggregating their values and the charging scheme omits an applicable rate, the aggregation-based taxing proviso is invalid.
